# How many appealed households gave, and how much?

```{python}
#| label: setup-overview
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from hh.io import read_parquet
from hh.analytics.donors import TIER_LABELS
from hh.viz import style, money, pct, SEQUENTIAL_BLUE, CATEGORICAL

t = read_parquet("processed", "appeal_households.parquet")
ap = t[t["appealed"]].copy()
n_appealed = len(ap)
```

Response rates and dollars for the `{python} f"{n_appealed:,}"` appealed households,
cut by prior giving, engagement, and geography. Every cut counts the same thing:
a household is a **responder** if it gave to the FY26 annual-fund campaign in the
Oct 2025 – Jan 2026 window.

## Response by prior-giving tier

Prior giving = lifetime SUCCEEDED individual gifts **before October 1, 2025**,
rolled up to the household, in the same four tiers the public book uses.

```{python}
#| label: fig-rate-by-tier
#| fig-cap: "Response rate by prior-lifetime-giving tier (never-donors shown separately)"
tiers = TIER_LABELS + ["never gave"]
rows = []
for tier in TIER_LABELS:
    part = ap[ap["prior_size_tier"] == tier]
    rows.append(
        {
            "prior giving": tier,
            "households": len(part),
            "responded": int(part["responded"].sum()),
            "rate": part["responded"].mean(),
            "dollars": part["afd_amount"].sum(),
        }
    )
part = ap[~ap["prior_donor"]]
rows.append(
    {
        "prior giving": "never gave",
        "households": len(part),
        "responded": int(part["responded"].sum()),
        "rate": part["responded"].mean(),
        "dollars": part["afd_amount"].sum(),
    }
)
by_tier = pd.DataFrame(rows)

fig = px.bar(by_tier, x="prior giving", y="rate")
fig.update_traces(texttemplate=[pct(r) for r in by_tier["rate"]], textposition="outside")
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Prior lifetime giving", yaxis_title="Share of households that responded",
    yaxis_tickformat=".0%",
)
fig.update_traces(marker_color=SEQUENTIAL_BLUE[7])
style(fig).show()
```

```{python}
by_tier["rate"] = by_tier["rate"].map(pct)
by_tier["dollars"] = by_tier["dollars"].map(money)
by_tier["median responder gift"] = [
    money(ap[ap["prior_size_tier"] == tier]["afd_amount"][lambda s: s > 0].median())
    if tier in TIER_LABELS
    else money(part["afd_amount"][lambda s: s > 0].median())
    for tier in by_tier["prior giving"]
]
by_tier
```

## Response by prior-donor status

```{python}
rows = []
for label, mask in [
    ("gave in FY25 (year before appeal)", ap["prior_fy_donor"]),
    ("prior donor, not in FY25 (lapsed ≥1y)", ap["prior_donor"] & ~ap["prior_fy_donor"]),
    ("lapsed 24+ months", ap["lapsed_donor"]),
    ("never gave", ~ap["prior_donor"]),
]:
    part = ap[mask.fillna(False)]
    rows.append(
        {
            "group": label,
            "households": len(part),
            "responded": int(part["responded"].sum()),
            "rate": pct(part["responded"].mean()),
            "dollars": money(part["afd_amount"].sum()),
        }
    )
pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

## Response by engagement before the appeal

Engagement counts only activity that happened **before the appeal mailed** —
events that started on or before September 30, 2025 (registrations for later
events don't count).

```{python}
#| label: fig-rate-by-profile
#| fig-cap: "Response rate by pre-appeal engagement profile"
order = ["arts+class", "arts", "class", "community/other", "none"]
rows = []
for prof in order:
    part = ap[ap["eng_profile"] == prof]
    rows.append(
        {
            "engagement": prof,
            "households": len(part),
            "responded": int(part["responded"].sum()),
            "rate": part["responded"].mean(),
        }
    )
by_prof = pd.DataFrame(rows)

fig = px.bar(by_prof, x="engagement", y="rate")
fig.update_traces(
    texttemplate=[pct(r) for r in by_prof["rate"]], textposition="outside",
    marker_color=SEQUENTIAL_BLUE[7],
)
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Pre-appeal engagement (as of Oct 1, 2025)",
    yaxis_title="Share that responded",
    yaxis_tickformat=".0%",
)
style(fig).show()
```

```{python}
by_prof["rate"] = by_prof["rate"].map(pct)
by_prof
```

## Response by distance from the Hall

```{python}
dist = (
    ap.groupby("distance_band", observed=True)
    .agg(households=("id", "count"), responded=("responded", "sum"), dollars=("afd_amount", "sum"))
    .reset_index()
)
dist["rate"] = dist["responded"] / dist["households"]
dist["rate"] = dist["rate"].map(pct)
dist["dollars"] = dist["dollars"].map(money)
dist
```
